typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		RECORD_TYPE as string,
		RECORD_NUMBER as string,
		MEMBER_ID as string,
		BILLING_PROVIDER_MCD_ID as string,
		PA_NUMBER as string,
		PA_STATUS as string,
		AUTHORIZATION_SERVICE_CODE as string,
		MODIFIER_1 as string,
		MODIFIER_2 as string,
		MODIFIER_3 as string,
		MODIFIER_4 as string,
		AUTHORIZED_EFFECTIVE_DATE as string,
		AUTHORIZED_END_DATE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	procedureName: 'PR_WI_Prior_Auth_Daily_Extract',
	schemaName: 'WIExtracts',
	resultSet: true,
	format: 'procedure',
	staged:false) ~> OLESRCDetailSourceData
OLESRCDetailSourceData derive(RECORD_TYPE = RECORD_TYPE) ~> PlaceHolderCNTCountDetailRows
PlaceHolderCNTCountDetailRows sink(input(
		RECORD_NUMBER as string,
		AUTHORIZED_EFFECTIVE_DATE as string,
		BILLING_PROVIDER_MCD_ID as string,
		AUTHORIZATION_SERVICE_CODE as string,
		MODIFIER_4 as string,
		MODIFIER_1 as string,
		MODIFIER_2 as string,
		MODIFIER_3 as string,
		RECORD_TYPE as string,
		AUTHORIZED_END_DATE as string,
		MEMBER_ID as string,
		PA_NUMBER as string,
		PA_STATUS as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		RECORD_NUMBER,
		AUTHORIZED_EFFECTIVE_DATE,
		BILLING_PROVIDER_MCD_ID,
		AUTHORIZATION_SERVICE_CODE,
		MODIFIER_4,
		MODIFIER_1,
		MODIFIER_2,
		MODIFIER_3,
		RECORD_TYPE,
		AUTHORIZED_END_DATE,
		MEMBER_ID,
		PA_NUMBER,
		PA_STATUS)) ~> FFDSTDetailRowDestination
